title: an outside proof asks build_inspector's judges through codemother's inspect_wire
intention: A proof outside CodeMother asks any build_inspector judge it needs through inspect_wire's ask(), over a scratch bus of its own, and names its roots as arguments instead of writing the inspector's globals.
why: 149b9a1ab9c4 moves 66 outside proofs off importing build_inspector (RULE 1). Measured: they cannot, because nothing published lets them hold CodeMother on a bus, 13 judges they call are not answered, and 7 drive the inspector by writing its globals, which cannot cross a bus.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation); Law 7 (a refusal raises, never reads green); outline 9.4.3.3.4 (Q#88)
how: D1: ORDER. Builds on 266d39d56d06 (the inspect verb and inspect_wire), before 149b9a1ab9c4, whose proofs call ask(). Independent of 17d570c10390. D2: ask(judge, *args, **kwargs) in inspect_wire. The first call in a process enters scratch_bus (the cairn device's published tool), holds bus_shim and CodeMotherShim on one DeviceRoster, and keeps them for the process (one bus per proof module, closed at exit). Each call wire_encodes, requests codemother `inspect`, and returns wire_decode(data). accepted False raises: a judge that raised raises again carrying its type name and words; any other refusal raises naming the judge and the reason. The shim import stays inside codemother. D3: INSPECT_JUDGES grows claim_provenance, proofs_exist, constraint_enforcement_holds, crossing_fingerprints_verified, the_nest, declared_runners, _workflow_cursor, proof_covers_the_ticket, buildme_rides_the_rehearsal, build_started, _source_fingerprint, sieve_names, run_sieve, proven_space. SIEVES and _PROVEN_SPACE are not callables, so the inspector gains sieve_names() (sorted SIEVES keys), run_sieve(name, *args, **kwargs) and proven_space() (sorted list) and those are what is listed. D4: buildme_rides_the_chart, proved_answers_the_chart, buildme_rides_the_intent, buildme_rides_the_sorted, forwarding_order_resolves take berths=, roots= and tickets_root= keyword arguments, each defaulting to None meaning the module global (_CHART_BERTHS, _crossing_roots(), _TICKETS_ROOT), threaded down to the private readers (_charted_packets, forwarding_residue, _component_tickets, _forwarding_map, _hand_order_index). Behaviour with no kwarg is unchanged. D5: PROOF, one tooth per falsifier clause, over a scratch bus (NOTRUN with no Postgres, 9.4.8.1).

clauses.claim: ask(judge, *args, **kwargs) from inspect_wire answers equal to the direct call for an allow-listed judge on a fixture
ask on a judge off the allow-list raises, naming the judge, and a judge that raised over the bus raises again by its type name
two asks in one process mint one scratch bus

each of claim_provenance, proofs_exist, constraint_enforcement_holds, crossing_fingerprints_verified, the_nest, declared_runners, _workflow_cursor, proof_covers_the_ticket, buildme_rides_the_rehearsal, build_started, _source_fingerprint, sieve_names, run_sieve, proven_space answers over ask
buildme_rides_the_chart, proved_answers_the_chart and buildme_rides_the_sorted given berths=, roots= and tickets_root= read the fixture they name with no inspector global written

measured.saw: AST census 2026-11-13 of 149b9a1ab9c4's 76 bounds files at 83051285b: 45 call only allow-listed judges; off INSPECT_JUDGES are SIEVES (4 files), claim_provenance (2), constraint_enforcement_holds, crossing_fingerprints_verified, proofs_exist, the_nest, declared_runners, _PROVEN_SPACE, _workflow_cursor, proof_covers_the_ticket, buildme_rides_the_rehearsal, build_started, _source_fingerprint; 7 proofs write inspector globals (_CHART_BERTHS 5, _crossing_roots 4, _TICKETS_ROOT 1); and the only way to hold CodeMother on a scratch bus is importing cairn.devices.codemother.shim, which outside codemother is a RULE 1 breach (git grep CodeMotherShim outside codemother: validation JSON only)
measured.how: AST read of each bounds.in file of 149b9a1ab9c4 in worktree cairn-149b at 83051285b
